messages:
kevin: incident-bot alerted p99 latency spike on prod-runtime us-west-2 pool (~620ms). seeing drop in rps on kernel-cuda11 path. @li can you grab a flameprof and KV stats?
incident-bot: Incident detected: service=runtime; severity=high; metric=p99_latency; value=620ms; affected_tenants=[42,73]; runbook=/runbooks/perf-high-latency
li: looking. quick check: KV cache eviction rate up ~4x in pool-3, continuous batch sizes collapsed to 1 for a lot of requests. noisy tenant 42 is hammering small-prefix traffic. starting profile and kcache dump now.
maria: On standby. I can flip feature flag `batching_experimental_v2` off in prod (flag-service) if that helps. throttle tenant 42? :thumbsup:
kevin: yes throttle tenant-42 to 10rps and route it to fallback quantized model (redwood-quant-cpu). also pin kernel selection for pool-3 to previous kernel.
rachel: executing flag toggle: `curl -X POST https://ff.redwood/api/toggles/batching_experimental_v2 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"env":"prod","value":false}'` -> 200 OK
deploy-bot: Feature flag toggle recorded by rachel at 1992345685
li: flameprof finished, snippet below:
```
hotspots:
  kernel_select: 45%
  kv_cache_lookup: 30%
  batch_chooser: 15%
  other: 10%
```
li: kernel_select path is preferring `fused-attn-v3` which shows regression vs v2 (p95 kernel switch latency ~2x). also seeing more KV lookups because batching kept failing to merge prefixes.
maria: I'm pinning kernel selection to `fused-attn-v2` for us-west-2 runtime-pool-3 now (`/ops/runtime set-kernel --pool pool-3 --kernel fused-attn-v2`) -> acknowledged.
tom: routing change applied: `redwood-router set-route --pool us-west-2 --tenant 42 --model redwood-quant-cpu` -> OK (1992345689)
incident-bot: Action recorded: throttle applied to tenant 42 at 1992345692 (rate=10rps); routing override applied.
kevin: monitoring p99 and aggregate rps. if p99 not < 250ms within 5m, prepare to pause the autoscaler and disable the experimental batching rollout.
li: after toggles: KV eviction rate down to baseline, batching sizes climbing back to median ~8, p99 dropped to 210ms within ~2m. noisy tenant's RPS cut by 80%.
rachel: opening follow-up: ticket PERF-534 to revert kernel auto-roll and add kernel regression gating in CI. attaching flameprof and kcache logs. https://git.redwood/ops/pulls/2873
maria: we should add a perf gate to CI that runs a small kernel-switch microbenchmark and checks p95/p99 delta before allowing rollout. will draft RFC.
kevin: agreed — add to postmortem. nice quick coordination everyone :tada: 
kevin: incident resolved for now, closing thread. ping me or reopen if we see re-occurrence.
